[templates] Template "x-fallback-misnested" does not compile with its Strengths / Soft Skills section removed or its sections moved, so it is drawn with both sections in place and in its own section order: a switched-off list prints empty, its heading may still print, and the resume's section order is not applied. A Handlebars block ({{#if}}, {{#each}}) probably opens inside a section's element and closes outside it; move it wholly inside or outside.

[templates] Template "x-fallback-misnested" cannot be drawn in the resume's section order: a Handlebars block opens inside one of its sections and closes outside it, so its sections print in the template's own order. Move the block wholly inside or outside the section.
